note: Formula money is allocated by a statutory or published rule rather than by project-by-project decision: per-capita or per-student grants, revenue sharing, per-bed or per-space operating rates, entitlement rebates, cost-share policing and health agreements, core First Nation funding under comprehensive funding arrangements or self-government agreements, and riding-quota programs such as Canada Summer Jobs. Everything else, including peer-reviewed research competitions, application-based infrastructure and business funds, settlement and social-service contracts and named-recipient grants, is treated as discretionary: when in doubt a program is left discretionary. For 'by':'program' levels each regex is matched case-insensitively against 'Department | Program' (Alberta and Saskatchewan: the ministry-prefixed program label); for 'by':'recipient' levels (BC, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Ontario, whose public accounts carry no program) it is matched against 'Department | Recipient name' so a class can be limited to one department. share_check counts adjusted dollars in each page's after window; the first matching regex wins. PEI and Quebec use the federal entry.
